question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.

WITH week_info AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT week_number, week_date_formatted
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
),
before_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
after_period AS (
    SELECT 
        region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
        AVG(sales) as avg_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        b.region, b.platform, b.age_band, b.demographic, b.customer_type,
        b.avg_sales_before, a.avg_sales_after,
        ROUND((a.avg_sales_after - b.avg_sales_before) * 100.0 / b.avg_sales_before, 2) as pct_change
    FROM before_period b
    JOIN after_period a ON 
        b.region = a.region AND 
        b.platform = a.platform AND 
        b.age_band = a.age_band AND 
        b.demographic = a.demographic AND 
        b.customer_type = a.customer_type
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY region
),
platform_stats AS (
    SELECT platform, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_stats AS (
    SELECT age_band, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_stats AS (
    SELECT demographic, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_stats AS (
    SELECT customer_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY customer_type
)
SELECT 
    'region' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM region_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'platform' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM platform_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'age_band' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM age_band_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'demographic' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM demographic_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'customer_type' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(avg_pct_change), 2) as overall_avg_pct_change
FROM customer_type_stats
ORDER BY overall_avg_pct_change
